title: SMC/ICT trade journal record, version 1
description: One closed trade appended as one JSON line to a trade journal. Timestamps are broker-local wall-clock times, without a UTC suffix or offset. Unknown properties are permitted for additive version 1 extensions. The `default` annotations document producer defaults only; a consumer must not use them to repair an incomplete record. Semantic invariants that JSON Schema cannot express (finite numbers, close_time >= open_time, entry_price > 0) are enforced by the analyzer, not here.

variant.description: Ablation label identifying which strategy layers were active, e.g. "full" or "no-trigger".

config_hash.description: Digest of the EA parameter set that produced this trade, so a saved report can be traced back to its inputs.

sl.description: Stop loss price. 0 means no stop was set; it is not interchangeable with an absent field.

tp.description: Take profit price. 0 means no target was set.

net_profit.description: gross_profit + commission + swap as reported by the terminal.

intended_risk_pct.description: Risk the EA asked for, e.g. SmcConfig InpRiskPercent.

realized_risk_pct.description: Actual outcome as a percentage of balance_at_open. Meaningful for losing trades; the gap against intended_risk_pct is what exposes lot-step granularity limits.

mfe.description: Maximum favourable excursion in price units, measured from entry_price over the bars the position was open. Non-negative by definition.

mae.description: Maximum adverse excursion in price units, measured from entry_price. Non-positive by definition, so a stop at distance d is breached when mae <= -d.

zone_percent.description: CSmcPremiumDiscount::GetZonePercent() at entry: 0 = swing low, 50 = equilibrium, 100 = swing high.

zone_types.description: Pipe-delimited overlapping zone types at entry, e.g. "OB|BPR|IFVG". "none" when no zone qualified; never an empty string.

session.description: Broker-local session label at entry. Labels are not time-zone conversions.
